comment: Independent C-first human Priest with msg_window:single. A 52-byte #name answer for the mace, holding 0xF4 at the end of the first row and 0xE5 on the second, makes the getlin line wrap at the terminal edge. Ctrl-P (step 62) reaches topl.c redotoplin(): putsyms() prints row 0 over what was there, topl_putsym('\n') clears row 1 before printing it, and recorder patch 006's nomux_putch() ignores both high bytes as negative chars, so those cells keep the old byte and the blank.
